name: New Fauna
description: Eight new creatures roam the rim on top of the rim herds: void whales, hunter packs, hull grazers, storm drifters, lantern shoals, nest mothers, scavengers and brood carriers. Rim herders tame whales and hunter packs as living freighters and miners.

flags.name: newFauna
flags.label: New fauna
flags.description: The eight rim creature variants (spawned rim-weighted on the rim-fauna density curve), their behaviours, and the tamed harness look for creatures docile to herders.
